title: 20260420 - What is GitOps and why should you care

chapters.title: Infrastructure as code and its limitations
Creating, modifying and reverting infrastructure changes
Drift detection workflow and real-world implementation
Infrastructure, applications, and configurations as code
When to use GitOps and implementation best practices
Benefits of GitOps and Q&A on adoption

features.name: GitOps declarative approach
features.description: GitOps uses declarative configuration to describe desired state rather than imperative commands, enabling Git as single source of truth with security and compliance checks at PR level.

features.name: GitOps pull-based reconciliation
features.description: GitOps engine uses pull-based approach to automatically ensure infrastructure matches desired state defined in Git repository, automatically detecting and resolving drift.

features.name: GitOps drift detection and remediation
features.description: GitOps automatically detects when actual infrastructure state diverges from desired state in Git and applies changes to restore alignment, with monitoring and notifications for non-remediable drift.

features.name: Infrastructure as Code with versioning
features.description: Infrastructure as Code enables defining infrastructure in versioned code files, allowing git history tracking, pull requests with change explanations, and reproducible deployments.

features.name: GitOps workflow
features.description: A software development workflow where infrastructure definitions are stored in a Git repository, pulled by a GitOps tool, and automatically synchronized to match the desired state without manual intervention.

features.name: Argo CD
features.description: A GitOps tool that pulls changes from a Git repository and synchronizes them to a Kubernetes cluster, monitoring the cluster to ensure reality matches the defined state.

features.name: Crossplane
features.description: An infrastructure as code tool that is Kubernetes native and GitOps friendly, allowing deployment of cloud resources and dependent resources in a Kubernetes cluster.

features.name: Kubernetes container orchestration
features.description: A de facto standard orchestration engine for container workloads that manages containers with dependencies and is used by major tech companies and cloud services.

features.name: Pull request and feature branch workflow
features.description: A software development process where changes are made on feature branches, reviewed via pull requests, and merged to the main branch, enabling collaborative development with verification and approval steps.

features.name: Auto-sync capability
features.description: An Argo CD feature that automatically synchronizes changes from the Git repository to the Kubernetes cluster without requiring manual intervention.

features.name: Git revert for change rollback
features.description: A Git feature that allows reverting accidental changes by reversing specific commits, enabling simple undo functionality for infrastructure changes managed through GitOps.

features.name: Resource pruning with safety check
features.description: An Argo CD feature that allows deletion of resources defined in Git, with an optional security mechanism requiring explicit checkbox confirmation before resource removal.

features.name: Git audit history for infrastructure changes
features.description: Complete audit trail stored in Git repositories showing all infrastructure changes, including additions, modifications, reversions, and deletions with commit history.

features.name: Multi-cluster GitOps management
features.description: GitOps approach to manage multiple Kubernetes clusters with similar configurations across test, customer, and internal environments using pull requests and Argo CD for progressing changes.
caveats: Requires similar cluster configurations with small differences

features.name: Infrastructure as YAML in Git
features.description: Azure Kubernetes Service clusters defined as YAML configuration in Git, including location, Kubernetes version, node pools, number of nodes, and node sizes.

features.name: Application versioning and configuration in Git
features.description: Applications running on Kubernetes clusters stored in Git with versions and environment-specific configurations, such as replica counts for test vs production clusters.

features.name: Encrypted secrets in Git repositories
features.description: Business Central development licenses and other secrets encrypted within Git repositories, automatically decrypted by Argo CD during synchronization for use by containers.

features.name: Automated API version updates via pull requests
features.description: Automated build service creates pull requests in GitOps repositories proposing version updates for APIs, requiring only approval from developers for rollout via Argo CD synchronization.

features.name: GitOps for infrastructure change reviews
features.description: Manual pull request workflow for larger infrastructure changes like adding node pools or changing VM sizes, with colleague reviews and automated checks to prevent accidental breaking changes.

features.name: GitOps for cloud-native scenarios
features.description: GitOps recommended for cloud-native scenarios including Kubernetes clusters and all applications, networking, and storage running on top of them.

features.name: GitOps for similar multi-environment management
features.description: GitOps useful for managing multiple similar environments like test, production, and staging that require mostly the same configuration with only small differences.

features.name: GitOps implementation considerations
features.description: Recommendations to research GitOps tools, repository structure decisions, access control, and definition structure before implementation. Start with small pilot projects and minimal structure.
caveats: Requires time for proper setup that works with existing processes

features.name: Self-healing infrastructure with drift detection
features.description: GitOps tools like Argo CD with Crossplane detect drift between Git state and actual infrastructure state, automatically reconciling differences for self-healing capabilities.

features.name: Git-based infrastructure workflow using Copilot
features.description: Use Git-based workflows to manage infrastructure like software, with Copilot integration to write infrastructure definitions and Code Review tools for review.

features.name: Cosmo Alpaca
features.description: A toolset for Business Central that runs on Azure Kubernetes Service, hosting BC containers and C# APIs across multiple clusters with GitOps-based configuration management.
